cost_accounting.policy: Use bounded uncached peak rates; failed/unverified calls retain full reservation.

decision: Inspect all bindings and unsupported extras against frozen source references. Any wrong/missing key guard/target/API decomposition blocks adopting inventory as reliable authority; a positive pilot only authorizes a further bounded comparison, not default promotion.
limitations: Three exposed tasks, one draw each; no stability or qualification claim.
Same-source LLM inventories are fallible correlated observations, not gold.
Literal quote validation is not semantic evidence.
No code outcomes, protected tasks, Pair or paper changes.
paired_model_comparison: Both three-case batches declared before either new output. Interface version differs from earlier thinking pilot, so that earlier run is not a clean thinking ablation.
purpose: Correct incomplete source anchoring and undisclosed mechanical constraints, then compare two fixed model configurations on the same three exposed tasks; no repair/resampling.
